ability.name: Paragon of Hysh
ability.effect: You can re-roll the charge roll or casting roll for that ability.

ability.name: Masterful Tactician
ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: Perfect Strike
ability.effect: Inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Aetherquartz Requisitioner
ability.effect: Add 3 to the casting roll for that spell.

ability.name: Martial Perfectionist
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords Infantry^^** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is damaged or that had any models slain this turn to be the target.

ability.name: Flawless Commander
ability.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords Infantry^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
